$comment: Ares model distribution manifest (see docs/MODEL-DISTRIBUTION.md). Source of truth for which trained model the app pulls. Each tier points at an immutable HuggingFace file URL plus its SHA-256 (the trust anchor: the download is rejected unless it matches). A tier is 'pullable' only when BOTH url and sha256 are non-empty; until a model is published, leave sha256 empty and the app falls back to building Ares from a stock qwen3 base. To publish: build the GGUF, `hf upload tburns-actual/legion-ares <file>`, then fill url+sha256+size_bytes here and bump model_version.
